title: E(G)=3n^2-3n (SidonModNeg, r=2) and its hypothesis are the SAME char-p coincidence wall that gates the all-witness count AND the Gauss-period (deep-moment) house
reduced_to: The honest, salvageable content (object-level, NOT scale-level): all four faces really do draw on ONE relation supply -- whether a nonzero {-1,0,1}-vector c of 2^mu-th roots vanishes mod p while being nonzero in C (a genuine = non-char-0 relation). SidonModNeg(mu_n) failure IS exactly a genuine support-<=4 relation (a+b-c-d=0, {a,b}!={c,d}, a+b!=0); the e_2=0 / four-term cyclotomic-resultant face is the same support-4 object with |Res(Phi_n,fourTerm)|^2 <= 8^{phi(n)} (SidonResultantImproved.lean, axiom-clean); the W-anomaly is E_r^{Fp} > E_r^{char0} = a signed 2r-relation. So the FOUR faces are instances of ONE decidable predicate `NoGenuineVanishingRelation(mu_n, p, s)`. The honest reduced statement is C033's already-recorded one extended to r=2: 'the faces share ONE relation-supply object', NOT 'one char-p coincidence wall gates all four'.
wall: W-BGK / W-anomaly. The deep-moment / Gauss-period (BGK) face is governed at relation length 2r ~ 2 log q (= 288 at the prize n=2^32, q~n^4.5); CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold.lean's clean range (2r)^{phi(n)}
evidence: Exact integer arithmetic, dyadic mu_n at PROPER-subgroup large primes (n=8,16,32; multiple primes per n). Probes: scripts/probes/_407_conn/C086_three_scales.py and C086_prize_regime.py. (1) SCALE SEPARATION (the decisive computation): the SidonModNeg (r=2) face is a FIXED support-4 +-1-relation question, independent of n; the deep BGK face needs length 2r ~ 2*beta*log2(n). Tabulated: n=8 -> 4 vs 27; n=16 -> 4 vs 36; n=32 -> 4 vs 45; n=2^32 -> 4 vs 288. They cannot be 'the same wall' -- fixed length 4 vs growing 2*beta*log n. (Matches C033's already-recorded count<->energy split by factor beta*H(rho)~3.65, here pushed to the even-shallower r=2 / support-4 end.) (2) PRIZE-REGIME r=2 face is CLEAN: at all 18 prize-shaped primes (n=8,16,32, beta in {4.0,4.5,5.0}, q=1 mod n, proper subgroup, large prime, n/sqrt(q) in [0.005, 0.12]) the exact additive energy E^{Fp}(mu_n) = 3n^2-3n EXACTLY (excess=0), i.e. SidonModNeg HOLDS throughout -- and the r=2 statistic B=sqrt(E_2/n) is even Ramanujan (4.58<=2sqrt8=5.66, 6.71<=8, 9.64<=11.31). So the r=2 / four-term-resultant face is provably the GOOD/Sidon regime at prize scale (consistent with SidonResultantImproved's unconditional Sidon regime n<(4/3)log2 p and with C031's E_2(mu_n)~3n^2 finding), NOT a wall. (3) The connection's own flagged TENSION is RESOLVED in its favor: the e_2=0 / Section-5.7 'no BGK wall' claim is CORRECT precisely because e_2=0 is the r=2 / four-term-resultant-HEIGHT face (|Res|^2<=8^{phi(n)}, threshold p>2^{3n/4}), which is provable far below the BGK depth -- exactly as why_insightful conjectured ('e_2=0's freedom from BGK must come from the resultant-height threshold, not from avoiding the coincidence count'). The four faces share the OBJECT but live at THREE scales: r=2/support-4 (SidonModNeg, e_2=0, four-term resultant, all CLEAN at prize), count/floor s*~2.5 log n (C033), deep BGK 2 log q (the open wall).
honest_note: Two-sided, no closure; same verdict family as C033 (PARTIAL) but for the r=2 anchor. CORRECT and useful: the OBJECT unification -- SidonModNeg, the e_2=0/four-term-resultant rigidity, the all-witness fit dichotomy, and the W-anomaly are all instances of one {-1,0,1}-cyclotomic-relation-mod-p predicate -- is a genuine, previously-half-recorded sharpening, and the cited Lean files (AdditiveEnergySidonModNeg.additiveEnergy_eq_of_sidonModNeg, EnergyCharacterTransport.sidon_order_of_sqrt_charSum, SidonResultantImproved.abs_resultant_fourTerm_sq_le) are genuine and axiom-clean as read. OVERCLAIMED and the decisive correction: 'the SAME char-p coincidence wall gates all four' is too strong. SidonModNeg/e_2=0 are r=2/support-4 (FIXED length, height threshold p>2^{3n/4} via phi(n)=n/2; CLEAN and effectively decided at prize scale); the Gauss-period/deep-moment house is the r~log q / length-2 log q BGK wall (open). A single predicate at one support cannot gate both: relation-freeness at support 4 discharges the SidonModNeg/e_2=0 face only, NOT the deep energy / Gauss-period house. So C086 correctly unifies THE OBJECT but mis-unifies THE SCALE, and it welds the load-bearing (Gauss-period) face back to W-BGK/W-anomaly. The attack-plan's hope that one Prop NoShortVanishingRelation closes all three together is therefore FALSE: it closes the shallow (r=2) trio, not the deep house -- which is the very part that matters for delta*. CAVEATS: deep-moment exact DP infeasible at prize primes (the 2r~2 log q scale asserted via the depth argument + CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold, computed only at small beta~2 primes where everything collapses to r=2 -- the #400 trap, explicitly excluded); SidonModNeg=excess=0 verified exactly at n<=32 prize primes (n=64 search timed out / output-buffering issue, not needed); prize-scale SidonModNeg at the deployed n=2^30 is empirically overwhelming (O160) but its proof is the same p-dependent number-theoretic input, not forced exactly-zero by Weil; I did not build the cited oleans (axiom-cleanliness asserted from in-file #print axioms + read proofs). Recommend DISPROOF_LOG: 'C086 (like C033) object-unifies SidonModNeg/e_2=0/all-witness/W-anomaly as one {-1,0,1}-relation-mod-p supply, but the SAME-WALL claim is REFUTED on scale: r=2/support-4 (SidonModNeg, e_2=0, four-term resultant) is CLEAN at prize (E=3n^2-3n exactly at 18 prize primes, B Ramanujan), fixed length 4; the Gauss-period/deep-moment house needs 2r~2 log q (=288 at n=2^32) = the open BGK wall. The flagged Section-5.7 e_2=0-no-BGK tension RESOLVES in the connection's favor: freedom is from the resultant-height threshold, not the coincidence count.'
